title: Neon + Opus have really helped move my game along :)
author: Aervale

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body: Looks good so far. What did Neon do that Opus couldnt? I'm not familiar with Neon.

replies.author: Aervale
replies.body: I don't think there's much Opus couldn't do but Neon just does things so well on the first try and the iterations feel easier. I'd say creativity is the biggest thing, Neon plans things and Opus is really good at sticking to the plans.

replies.author: Ok-Sea300
replies.body:
You're right about that. Opus can't plan anything long to save it's life. I'll have to try neon.

Have you compared it against Grok? Grok will actually write a kill quest where Claude says we need to go neutralize the enemy, and if they are bad bad guys we can "let them go" (which ive found to be cryptic for "kill")...

But claude can code like crazy so... lol
